summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Music Journal app. 23/23 backend pytest tests passed (public submit validation, platform detection, auth/me, admin RBAC, admin CRUD, score recomputation, bulk publish, delete, CSV/XLSX export with Semua Kelas sheet, results_public toggle, public/results field filtering, AI background grading pipeline pending->processing->graded). Frontend: /submit form, platform badge, invalid vimeo warning, exact bilingual success banner all work; /results mobile responsive with disabled banner and published-only field exposure; /dashboard admin loads with stats/filters/review sheet; non-admin shows banner-not-admin; unauth redirects to /login.

issues: Radix a11y warning: DialogContent missing DialogTitle/Description (Sheet component). Non-blocking but should wrap title with VisuallyHidden or set accessible title to silence screen reader warnings.
Placeholder shows '1–40' but backend accepts 1–60. Minor copy mismatch.

action_items: (Optional) Wrap Sheet title with VisuallyHidden or supply SheetTitle/SheetDescription to resolve Radix a11y warnings in review sheet.
(Optional) Align SubmitPage attendance placeholder '1–40' with backend max of 60.
critical_code_review_comments: AI grading uses Gemini and can return 0 when metadata insufficient (e.g., non-music video). Expected; consider surfacing data_confidence prominently to teacher.
db.settings.admin is upserted via $setOnInsert on every successful OAuth login, which prevents accidental overwrite - good.
Metadata fetch uses facebookexternalhit UA and may hit rate limits on IG/FB; expected and acknowledged.
server.py exceeds 500+ lines; could be split into routers (auth/public/admin/export) for maintainability but not critical.
Cookie flags secure=True, SameSite=None require HTTPS which is correct for preview env.
test_credentials: Admin email: raraaaghs22@gmail.com (seeded in db.settings). Admin sessions were created directly in MongoDB per /app/auth_testing.md. All TEST_ data, test sessions and non-admin test users were cleaned up. results_public restored to false.
seed_data_creation: Temporary seeded 3 TEST_UI Seed submissions in XI 1 + 1 submit flow record (all cleaned). Also created temporary admin + non-admin sessions (deleted after tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py is pytest-based and reusable for regression. Uses pymongo directly to seed admin sessions (auth_testing.md pattern). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. The 'slow' marker (test_background_grading_progresses) exercises real Emergent LLM Gemini and takes ~15-30s.
